sn37.9:1.1: Pañcahi Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || Assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottāpī ca hoti aticārī ca hoti duppañño ca hoti || || Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || upapajjatī ti || ||
